Relations: "has former name" maybe "formerly called". "claims to control" could be "controls" relation. "MP3 licensing of the Layer 3 patents" maybe object: "MP3 licensing" or "Layer 3 patents". Could be "controls licensing of Layer 3 patents". Also "enforcing these patents" -> relation "enforces" with object "Layer 3 patents". Also "in many countries" with qualifiers list of countries.
